# Quaderno

Quaderno is a tax compliance platform that automates tax calculations, invoicing, and reporting for businesses worldwide.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/quaderno/.

## Actions

- **Calculate Tax Rate** (read-only): Calculate applicable tax rate for given address and transaction type.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact (customer or vendor).
- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **Create Product**: Create a new product.
- **Delete Coupon**: Permanently delete a coupon.
- **Delete Expense**: Permanently delete an expense by id.
- **Delete Product**: Permanently delete a product by id.
- **Delete Tax ID**: Permanently delete a registered tax id by id.
- **Deliver Credit Note**: Deliver a credit note to the customer via email.
- **Deliver Invoice**: Deliver an invoice to the customer via email.
- **List Contacts**: List contacts, paginated and filterable by name, email, or tax id.
- **List Coupons**: List all coupons.
- **List Evidence**: List all evidence objects.
- **List Expenses**: List all expenses, paginated.
- **List Products**: List all products.
- **List Registered Tax IDs**: List all registered tax ids.
- **List Reporting Requests**: List all reporting requests.
- **List Sessions**: List all quaderno checkout sessions, paginated and filterable by status.
- **List Tax Codes**: List all supported tax codes.
- **List Tax Jurisdictions**: List all tax jurisdictions.
- **List Webhooks**: List all webhooks.
- **Retrieve Contact**: Retrieve details of an existing contact by id.
- **Retrieve Coupon**: Retrieve details of an existing coupon by id.
- **Retrieve Evidence**: Retrieve details of an existing evidence object by id.
- **Retrieve Invoice**: Retrieve details of an existing invoice by id.
- **Retrieve Product**: Retrieve details of an existing product by id.
- **Retrieve Tax Jurisdiction**: Retrieve a tax jurisdiction by id.
- **Update Credit Note**: Update a credit note.
- **Update Invoice**: Update an invoice.
- **Update product**: Update a product.
- **Validate Tax ID**: Validate a tax id.
- **Void Credit Note**: Void a credit note.
